# Al Haya Sofa Care UAE

> Al Haya Sofa Care UAE is a professional sofa, couch and upholstery cleaning company based in Al Nahda, Dubai, serving all seven emirates of the UAE. We provide at-home deep shampoo cleaning, steam sanitization, stain and odour removal, leather care and pet-hair removal — same-day service, eco-friendly products, most fabric sofas dry within 3–4 hours. Booking via phone/WhatsApp: +971 54 719 9189.

## Key facts
- Business name: Al Haya Sofa Care UAE
- Service: Sofa, couch and upholstery cleaning (at-home / doorstep)

- Fastest response: Al Nahda Dubai, Al Qusais, Muhaisnah, Deira, Al Warqa and Al Nahda Sharjah (closest to our base)
- Same-day service: Yes, usually when booked in the morning
- Eco-friendly & pet/child-safe products: Yes
- Drying time: most fabric sofas dry within 3–4 hours; thick or natural fibres up to 6–8 hours; leather can be used almost immediately

## Services (affordable pricing — free quote on WhatsApp)
- Sofa deep cleaning
- Sofa shampooing (foam)
- Sofa steam cleaning / sanitization (kills bacteria & dust mites)
- Sofa stain removal (coffee, tea, wine, food, ink, pet)
- Sofa odour removal (cooking, smoke, pet)
- Leather sofa cleaning & conditioning
- Pet hair removal
- Velvet, chenille & microfiber sofa cleaning (low-moisture method)
- Majlis seating, floor cushions, dining chairs and mattresses
- Office and hotel-apartment seating (after-hours scheduling)
- Fabric protection coating — available on request
- Handles all sizes: armchair, 2/3-seater, L-shaped, 7-seater; all fabrics incl. velvet, suede, microfiber, leather

## Frequently asked questions
- How much does sofa cleaning cost in Dubai? It depends on sofa size, fabric and condition; send a photo on WhatsApp +971 54 719 9189 for a free quote. At-home service, no hidden fees.
- Do you offer same-day sofa cleaning? Yes — usually same-day across Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman and Abu Dhabi when booked in the morning; fastest in Al Nahda, Al Qusais, Muhaisnah and Deira.
- How long does a sofa take to dry? Most fabric sofas are dry and usable within 3–4 hours thanks to extraction machines and air movers.
- Do I need to move my sofa? No — the team brings portable equipment (no water connection needed) and cleans at your home.
- Are the products safe for kids and pets? Yes — eco-friendly, non-toxic and rinsed out during extraction.
- What is the difference between shampoo and steam cleaning? Shampoo (foam) lifts oils, grease and dirt for general deep cleaning; steam uses high-temperature vapour to sanitise and kill bacteria and dust mites. Both can be combined.
- Do you clean leather, velvet, microfiber and majlis seating? Yes — pH-safe leather conditioning, low-moisture methods for velvet and microfiber, and full majlis sets in one visit.

Call or WhatsApp +971 54 719 9189, or use the contact page at https://sofashampooingdubai.com/contact. Free quotes; no hidden charges.
